set_option maxRecDepth 1000000
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

-- kcost: 5 s estimated per inherited finite check; at most 131 coefficient/list entries or 130 branch intervals. No generated bulk certificate is added; inspect first measured module before scaling.
theorem coefficientDenominator_pos : 0 < coefficientDenominator := by decide +kernel

-- kcost: 5 s estimated per inherited finite check; at most 131 coefficient/list entries or 130 branch intervals. No generated bulk certificate is added; inspect first measured module before scaling.
theorem powerCoefficients_eq_integerCoefficients :
    powerCoefficients = integerCoefficients.map
      (fun a : ℤ => (a : ℚ) / (coefficientDenominator : ℚ)) := by decide +kernel

def scaledValue (x : ℚ) : ℤ :=
  homogeneousHorner integerCoefficients x.num (x.den : ℤ)

def scaledUnit (x : ℚ) : ℤ :=
  coefficientDenominator * (x.den : ℤ) ^ integerCoefficients.length

theorem horner_lt_of_scaled (x : ℚ) (k : ℤ) (h : scaledValue x < k * scaledUnit x) :
    rationalHorner powerCoefficients x < (k : ℚ) := by
  rw [powerCoefficients_eq_integerCoefficients]
  exact rationalHorner_lt_of_homogeneous integerCoefficients coefficientDenominator
    coefficientDenominator_pos x k h

theorem lt_horner_of_scaled (x : ℚ) (k : ℤ) (h : k * scaledUnit x < scaledValue x) :
    (k : ℚ) < rationalHorner powerCoefficients x := by
  rw [powerCoefficients_eq_integerCoefficients]
  exact lt_rationalHorner_of_homogeneous integerCoefficients coefficientDenominator
    coefficientDenominator_pos x k h

end CatalanMeasure.Refinement.Trimmed130
